Projects.title: Projects
Projects.intro: Three business automation projects, delivered at Groupon.

items.title: IMOC RAG Incident Review Creator
items.body: A RAG system that writes structured incident post-mortems and makes incidents searchable. The incident management team uses it every day.
items.problem: Incident reviews took hours of manual work, with uneven documentation and no knowledge base to search.

items.title: HYPR AI Performance Review
items.body: An AI-assisted performance review system for more than 1,500 employees. It produces structured feedback and a score.
items.problem: Manual performance reviews were slow and open to subjective bias.

items.title: n8n Enterprise Workflows
items.body: 18 automation workflows in production: onboarding, reporting, alerting and data synchronisation between systems.
items.problem: Dozens of manual processes between Slack, Jira, Google Workspace and internal tools. They caused errors and lost time.

Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.intro: This site only collects the data you enter in the contact form. It uses no tracker and no audience-measurement cookie.
dataItems: Your phone number, if you enter it
Privacy.purposeBody: This data is used to answer your request and to offer you a website. It is not used for advertising or resold.
Privacy.basisBody: Your consent, given by ticking the box in the form.
Privacy.recipientsBody: Only me, through these services: Notion (storing requests), Resend (sending e-mails) and Vercel (site host). These services may process data outside the European Union, with the safeguards provided by the GDPR.
Privacy.rightsBody: You can access your data, correct it, erase it, object to its use or take a copy. Write to {email}. You can also contact the CNIL, the French data protection authority (cnil.fr).
Privacy.cookiesBody: No audience-measurement cookie, no advertising pixel. Fonts are served by this site, with no call to a third-party service from your browser.
